fixes:
[list]
[*] Settings does not applyed when you launch game.
[*] Climbing on any hills on level 5.
[*] Boss door sound volume does not affect by any settings.
[*] Battle music playing restarting caused by entering to next arena trigger.
[*] If player shot toilets before entering to arena, arena start.
[*] Save zone behing of final boss.
[*] Level 2 unkillable snipers.
[*] Some other levels bug fixes.
[*] Snowpity achivement unlocking when game started first time.
[*] Player Camera Jumping. ( if probblem still exist, please contact us )

[/list]
